notable_quotes: The crystal structure of Zn(PZDC)(ATZ) includes highly disordered free solvent molecules that could not be explicitly modeled.
Zn(PZDC)(ATZ) contains large solvent-accessible voids that account for 21.7% of the unit-cell volume.
The use of SQUEEZE to identify void space indicates porosity in Zn(PZDC)(ATZ) despite unresolved guest solvent positions.
